_metadata.description: deployment-manager calls bridge to native-build/test a scenario across target-OS nodes and aggregate a single cross-OS verdict.

requirements.title: Cross-OS Deployment Gate
requirements.description: deployment-manager can call bridge to run a cross-OS validation gate: distribute the built scenario, native-build/test it on each target-OS node, aggregate per-OS verdicts, and return a single 'production-ready on Ubuntu + macOS + Windows' result that gates promotion. Bridge supplies the capability; deployment-manager owns the verdict.

validation.notes: Per-OS node verdicts aggregate into a single pass/fail; any failing OS fails the gate with the offending logs surfaced.
deployment-manager invokes the gate over the API contract and receives a structured cross-OS result.
A scenario is validated green on real Ubuntu/macOS/Windows nodes before being marked production-ready.
